events.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up nicely—folks are bringing in all sorts of things. If you’re thinking of helping out, it seems like a good day to stop by.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I should probably swing by with something useful—I’ll try not to forget this time.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Tess: That’d be lovely—just bring whatever’s been sitting around needing a fix, and they’ll sort it out. If you forget, I’ll probably see you on the street and remind you!
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word and remind folks about the repair drive.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep an ear out if anyone has questions.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll keep reminding people and send them your way if they have questions.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Oren: Oh, right, Tess — I’ll bring something useful by, and maybe I can help sort the donated tools if I don’t wander off and forget again.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful, Oren — a little help sorting the tools would go a long way. And don’t worry, I’ll give you a friendly nudge if you start drifting off!
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Oren: Oh, good, I’d appreciate that nudge. I’ll stop by with something for the drive and help sort the tools, promise.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Tess: Oh, lovely — the repair drive’s been getting a nice bit of attention. If you’ve got anything needing a fix, just bring it by and I’ll make sure folks point you the right way.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — I’ve got my tools ready, and I can help steer folks your way if you need an extra hand.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be brilliant, Gus — an extra hand is always welcome. Just keep sending folks over, and I’ll be right here to help them out.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you helping spread the word. If anyone’s got questions or something to fix, send them my way and I’ll take care of it.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep reminding the neighbors about the repair drive and send any questions your way.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Tess: That’s wonderful, Vik — thanks again. I’ll be here with a warm welcome and a few spare tools if anyone stops by.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Hana: I’m checking the details first — what’s already been collected, and what still needs fixing?
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Tess: Oh, we’ve got a nice mix already — a few small appliances and some clothes needing mending. If you’d like, I can point you to the usual spot and you can have a look through the pile.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll check the pile first, then verify the address and parking details before I report back.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the timing and drop-off details, so I can pass them along and keep the repair drive on track.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Pia — I’m still gathering the timing and drop-off details too, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I have them.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep waiting on the timing and drop-off details, and I’ll share them as soon as they’re set.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you tell me what changed.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Tess: Oh, not much has changed—just a nice steady flow of folks dropping things off. If you swing by, I’ll point you to what needs sorting and what’s ready to be fixed.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Noah: Oh, good — I can do that. Point me where you need me, and I’ll start sorting.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Tess: Oh, lovely — the repair drive’s still humming along. If you’ve got anything that needs fixing, just bring it by and I’ll point you to the right place.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate that. I’ll let folks know they can bring anything by today.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — thank you, Sam. I’ll keep an eye out and make sure anyone who comes by gets pointed in the right direction.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Tess: Oh, lovely — the repair drive’s still getting a nice bit of attention. If you’ve got anything needing a fix, just bring it by and I’ll point you the right way.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — I’m waiting on the date so I can work around the school schedule and help organize it.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely — I’m still waiting on the timing and drop-off details, and I’ll pass them along as soon as I have them.
events.speaker: Tess
